`class ResourceNode`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.resource` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ResourceNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/resource/ResourceNode.java)

Draws an image resource in its bounds, tinted by a color, with an optional image that fades in on hover.

![A placeholder image crossed by two diagonals](/captures/catalog-nodes-resourcenode.webp)

## Description

The node waits for its resource: it draws its skeleton until the image is loaded.
Without a declared size it takes the size of the image; with one declared size, it keeps the ratio of the image on the other axis.
A resource that fails to load shows a checkerboard of 64 × 64 design pixels when no size is declared.
